transit.name: Durango & Silverton Narrow Gauge Railroad
transit.detail: Historic train from the Durango Depot to Silverton, about two hours in Silverton on the round trip; 2026 season May 2 to November 1

timeline.text: By July the railroad tracks from Durango to Silverton were completed and the train began hauling passengers and freight.
The two-story brick San Juan County Jail was built at a cost of $12,175; it is now part of the museum complex.
A contract was issued to build the Mayflower (Shenandoah-Dives) Mill two miles northeast of town.
The Mayflower Mill closed; it was later donated to the San Juan County Historical Society.
The Mayflower Mill was declared a National Historic Landmark.

ghostTowns.name: Animas Forks
ghostTowns.text: A mining town at 11,200 feet on the Alpine Loop, 12.3 miles by road from Silverton; its first cabin was built in 1873 and it was a ghost town by the 1920s.
